eventDetail.eventTitle: 2026 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Human-Computer Interaction and Robotics (AIHCIR)
eventDetail.about: Computing and Processing; General Topics for Engineers; Robotics and Control Systems
eventDetail.scope: AIHCIR 2026 focuses on advancing interdisciplinary research at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), and Robotics, covering critical areas such as intelligent systems design, knowledge acquisition and fusion, ergonomic user experiences, robot learning, machine learning applications, and AI-driven automation. The conference aims to explore innovative solutions for seamless human-AI collaboration, adaptive robotics, and data-driven decision-making in real-world scenarios.
